name: Typy.io
summary:
Typy.io is a multiplayer typing-territory .io game.

Up to six players share a hex board of 91 keycap tiles, each carrying a word.

You type the word on any tile touching your territory to claim it. Unclaimed tiles carry short 3-4 letter words, tiles held by a rival carry longer 5-7 letter words.

Lose your last tile and you are out for the round. Rounds last 3 minutes, and the player with the most tiles wins, or the last one standing.
